note: Three defect classes the lane's own gates could not see, found by the oracle-blind audit `script/m14/tmp/elixir-deep-audit.ts` (A8 range coverage measured off the TREE, A3 owner integrity) and by the tree census `script/m14/tmp/elixir-raise-census.ts`. (A8) A merged multi-clause definition kept only its FIRST clause's range while its own metadata said `heads: 2` — 2,321 merged groups in 559 elixir@024beb1b files, 184 in a 60-file ecto_sql slice (`def loaders/2` heads=7, range 211..211). The extent is now first clause .. LAST CLAUSE (the rule real-clean-analyzer.ts already applies to a multi-clause `f x = ...`), and every clause's exact range rides metadata.clauseRanges — necessary, not decorative: 195 of the 2,321 groups (8.4%) have OTHER declarations between their first and last clause, and `classify` below is exactly that shape (helper_of sits between clause 1 and clause 3). (A9) `raise Mod` / `raise Mod, msg` / `reraise Mod, stack` is a struct CONSTRUCTION through Kernel.raise's exception entry point — the same edge class the lane already emits for `struct/2` (ELXD19) and a `%Mod{}` literal — but it emitted nothing: 401 alias-named raise sites in 200 files of elixir@024beb1b carried no dependency edge. A bare `raise "msg"` names no type and stays silent. (A10) A nested `defmodule` carried NO ownerName/ownerKind, contradicting this lane's own symbol contract ('nested modules owned by the parent') and the M14 ledger ruling that `ownerName` is the innermost enclosing declaration (#867); 100% of nested-module symbols on the ecto_sql slice had it undefined, and only the indexer's `ownerName || scope` fallback kept the graph right. All three pins are per-class: mutant elixir/merged-head-range-first-clause, elixir/merged-head-clause-ranges-dropped, elixir/raise-no-instantiates and elixir/nested-module-ownerless each revert one of them.
